name: Merchant
desc: You were apprenticed to a trader, caravan master, or shopkeeper, learning the fundamentals of commerce. You traveled broadly, and you earned a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans need to practice their craft or finished works from such crafters.

feature.name: Lucky
desc: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment. You have 3 Luck Points. Whenever you make an d20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll. Alternatively, when a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give that creature Disadvantage on the roll. You regain all spent Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.

traits: I'm always looking for a bargain.
I have a story for every coin I've earned.
I don't part with my money easily.
I'm a bit of a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine goods.
I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing for a profit.
I'm well known for my fair (or unfair) dealings.
I like to talk at length about my travels.
ideals: Prosperity. Wealth is the key to a better life for everyone. (Good)
Fairness. A deal is a deal, and both sides should benefit. (Lawful)
Freedom. Everyone should be free to pursue their own livelihood. (Chaotic)
Greed. I'm only in it for the money. (Evil)
People. I'm loyal to my friends and family; the business comes second. (Neutral)
Aspiration. I work hard to be the wealthiest merchant in the land. (Any)
bonds: I'm trying to rebuild the family business that was destroyed.
I owe a great debt to the guild that trained me.
My life's work is to find the rarest spice in the world.
I pursue wealth to secure the love of my life.
One day I will return to my home and prove I'm more than just a street peddler.
I will get revenge on the rival who ruined my reputation.
flaws: I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my success.
I'm soft-hearted and can't resist a hard-luck story.
No one must ever learn that I once sold counterfeit goods.
I'm a perfectionist who can't finish a deal until it's flawless.
